blurb: Guests take one-hour narrated sightseeing cruises along the Detroit River, viewing Detroit and Windsor skylines, historic landmarks, and the working waterway. Tours depart from Cullen Plaza in Detroit. Private charters are available for groups, corporate events, weddings, and fundraisers on two charter boats.
